text:
Predicates:
BrownSwissCattle(x) ::: x is a Brown Swiss cattle.
Cow(x) ::: x is a cow.
Pet(x) ::: x is a pet.
Domesticated(x) ::: x is domesticated.
Alligator(x) ::: x is an alligator.
Ted ::: Ted.
Premises:
∀x (BrownSwissCattle(x) → Cow(x)) ::: All Brown Swiss cattle are cows.
∃x (Pet(x) ∧ BrownSwissCattle(x)) ::: Some pets are Brown Swiss cattle.
∀x (Cow(x) → Domesticated(x)) ::: All cows are domesticated animals.
¬∃x (Alligator(x) ∧ Domesticated(x)) ::: Alligators are not domesticated animals.
Alligator(Ted) ::: Ted is an alligator.
Conclusion:
∀x ((BrownSwissCattle(x) ∧ Ted) → ¬Pet(x)) ::: If Ted is a Brown Swiss cattle, then Ted is not a pet.
